title: Signature Easy Swing
technique: Play the left-hand stride leaps steadily under a stepwise right-hand melody, keeping the beat even and the hands balanced.
body: This is a complete original piano swing piano song in C major at 132 beats per minute in 4/4 time, built on the stride-swing framework across 32 bars in the form Intro A B A. The left hand carries the harmonic framework, playing the progression bar by bar, while the right hand carries a newly composed melody that moves stepwise with occasional leaps, staying inside the genre scale. To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is a Signature-original composition, newly composed for the Signature edition in the piano swing style. It is not a copy of any existing song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.

It is a Signature-original composition, newly composed for the Signature edition in the piano swing style. It is not a copy of any existing song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.

title: Signature Jump Swing
technique: Play the left-hand stride leaps with light syncopation in the right hand, accenting the off-beat notes without rushing the bar.
body: This is a complete original piano swing piano song in G major at 160 beats per minute in 4/4 time, built on the jump-swing framework across 32 bars in the form A B A Coda. The left hand carries the harmonic framework, playing the progression bar by bar, while the right hand carries a newly composed melody that moves stepwise with occasional leaps, staying inside the genre scale. To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is a Signature-original composition, newly composed for the Signature edition in the piano swing style. It is not a copy of any existing song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.

title: Signature Sixteen-Bar Swing
technique: Play the left-hand stride leaps with light syncopation in the right hand, accenting the off-beat notes without rushing the bar.
body: This is a complete original piano swing piano song in Eb major at 148 beats per minute in 4/4 time, built on the big-band piano framework across 32 bars in the form Intro A B A. The left hand carries the harmonic framework, playing the progression bar by bar, while the right hand carries a newly composed melody that moves stepwise with occasional leaps, staying inside the genre scale. To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is a Signature-original composition, newly composed for the Signature edition in the piano swing style. It is not a copy of any existing song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.

title: Signature Fast Stride
technique: Play the left-hand stride leaps with syncopated right-hand lines plus harmony notes on the strong beats, voicing the melody above the accompaniment.
body: This is a complete original piano swing piano song in D major at 140 beats per minute in 4/4 time, built on the stride-swing framework across 32 bars in the form A A B A. The left hand carries the harmonic framework, playing the progression bar by bar, while the right hand carries a newly composed melody that moves stepwise with occasional leaps, staying inside the genre scale. To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is a Signature-original composition, newly composed for the Signature edition in the piano swing style. It is not a copy of any existing song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.

title: Signature Swing Finale
technique: Play the left-hand stride leaps with syncopated right-hand lines plus harmony notes on the strong beats, voicing the melody above the accompaniment.
body: This is a complete original piano swing piano song in Bb major at 144 beats per minute in 4/4 time, built on the big-band piano framework across 32 bars in the form Intro A B A. The left hand carries the harmonic framework, playing the progression bar by bar, while the right hand carries a newly composed melody that moves stepwise with occasional leaps, staying inside the genre scale. To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is a Signature-original composition, newly composed for the Signature edition in the piano swing style. It is not a copy of any existing song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.
